130806.desc_cn: 黄泉造成的终结技伤害全属性抗性穿透提高20%，施放普攻、战技造成的伤害同时视为终结技伤害，并无视弱点属性削减敌方韧性。击破弱点时，触发雷属性的弱点击破效果。

130901.name: Land of Smiles
130901.desc: While the "Concerto" state is active, all allies' All-Type RES PEN increases by 24%.
130901.desc_cn: 处于【协奏】状态时，我方全体全属性抗性穿透提高24%。

130902.name: Afternoon Tea For Two
130902.desc: While the "Concerto" state is active, all allies' SPD increases by 16%. The Talent's Energy Regeneration effect additionally increases by 1.
130902.desc_cn: 处于【协奏】状态时，我方全体速度提高16%。天赋的能量恢复效果额外提高1点。

130903.name: Inverted Tuning
130903.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
130903.desc_cn: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级。

130904.name: Raindrop Key
130904.desc: When using the Ultimate, dispels Crowd Control debuffs from all allies. While Robin is in the "Concerto" state, increases the Effect RES of all allies by 50%.
130904.desc_cn: 施放终结技时，解除我方全体的控制类负面状态，使我方全体在知更鸟处于【协奏】状态期间的效果抵抗提高50%。

130905.name: Lonestar's Lament
130905.desc:
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
130905.desc_cn: 普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。

130906.name: Moonless Midnight
130906.desc: While the "Concerto" state is active, the CRIT DMG for the Physical Additional DMG caused by the Ultimate increases by 450%. The effect of "Moonless Midnight" can trigger up to 8 time(s) and the trigger count resets each time the Ultimate is used.
130906.desc_cn: 处于【协奏】状态时，终结技造成的物理属性附加伤害的暴击伤害额外提高450%。【月隐的午夜】效果最多触发8次，每次施放终结技时重置触发次数。

131001.name: In Reddened Chrysalis, I Once Rest
131001.desc: When using the Enhanced Skill, ignores 15% of the target's DEF. The Enhanced Skill does not consume Skill Points.
131001.desc_cn: 施放强化战技时无视目标15%的防御，且强化战技不消耗战技点。

131002.name: From Shattered Sky, I Free Fall
131002.desc: While in Complete Combustion, using the Enhanced Basic ATK or the Enhanced Skill to defeat an enemy target or to Break their Weakness allows SAM to immediately gain 1 extra turn. This effect can trigger again after 1 turn(s).
131002.desc_cn: 「完全燃烧」状态下施放强化普攻、强化战技消灭敌方目标或使目标陷入弱点击破状态时，装甲「萨姆」立即获得1个额外回合。该效果在1回合后可再次触发。

131003.name: Amidst Silenced Stars, I Deep Sleep
131003.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
131003.desc_cn: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级。

131004.name: Upon Lighted Fyrefly, I Soon Gaze
131004.desc: While in Complete Combustion, increases SAM's Effect RES by 50%.
131004.desc_cn: 「完全燃烧」状态下，装甲「萨姆」的效果抵抗提高50%。

131005.name: From Undreamt Night, I Thence Shine
131005.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
131005.desc_cn: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。

131006.name: In Finalized Morrow, I Full Bloom
131006.desc: While in Complete Combustion, increases SAM's Fire RES PEN by 20%. When using the Enhanced Basic ATK or Enhanced Skill, increases Weakness Break Efficiency by 50%.
131006.desc_cn: 「完全燃烧」状态下装甲「萨姆」的火属性抗性穿透提高20%。施放强化普攻、强化战技时弱点击破效率提高50%。

131201.name: Whimsicality of Fancy
131201.desc: When using the Ultimate, for every enemy on the field, additionally increases the Hits Per Action for the current Ultimate by 1 hit(s), up to a maximum increase of 5 hit(s).
131201.desc_cn: 施放终结技时，场上每有1个敌方目标，本次终结技的攻击段数额外增加1段，最多额外增加5段。

131202.name: Yearning of Youth
131202.desc: Before each hit of the Ultimate lands, there is a 24% base chance of reducing the target's DEF by 16% for 3 turn(s).
131202.desc_cn: 终结技每段攻击前，有24%的基础概率使目标防御力降低16%，持续3回合。

131203.name: Vestige of Happiness
131203.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
131203.desc_cn: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级。

131204.name: Visage of Kinship
131204.desc: Increases the DMG multiplier for each hit of the Ultimate by 6%.
131204.desc_cn: 终结技每段攻击的伤害倍率提高6%。

131205.name: Genesis of First Love
131205.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
131205.desc_cn: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。

131206.name: Estrangement of Dream
131206.desc: When using the Ultimate, increases own DMG by 30%, lasting until the end of the turn. In addition, the next time the Skill is used, recovers 1 Skill Point(s) for the team.
131206.desc_cn: 施放终结技时，使自身造成的伤害提高30%，持续至自身回合结束，且下一次施放战技后为我方恢复1个战技点。

131301.name: Millennium's Quietus
131301.desc: When Sunday uses Skill, the target character can ignore 16% of enemy target's DEF to deal DMG and their summon can ignore 40% of enemy target's DEF to deal DMG, lasting for 2 turn(s).
131301.desc_cn: 星期日施放战技时，使目标角色造成伤害时无视目标16%的防御力，召唤物造成伤害时无视目标40%的防御力，持续2回合。

131302.name: Faith Outstrips Frailty
131302.desc: After the first use of Ultimate, recovers 2 Skill Point(s). The DMG dealt by "The Beatified" increases by 30%.
131302.desc_cn: 首次施放终结技后恢复2个战技点。【蒙福者】造成的伤害提高30%。

131303.name: Hermitage of Thorns
131303.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
131303.desc_cn: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级。

131304.name: Sculpture's Preamble
131304.desc: When the turn starts, regenerates 8 Energy.
131304.desc_cn: 回合开始时，恢复8点能量。

131305.name: Paper Raft in Silver Bay
131305.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
131305.desc_cn: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。

131306.name: Dawn of Sidereal Cacophony
131306.desc: The Talent's CRIT Rate boost effect becomes stackable up to 3 time(s), and the Talent's duration increases by 1 turn(s). When Sunday uses Ultimate, can also apply the Talent's CRIT Rate boost effect to the target. When the Talent's CRIT Rate boost takes effect and the target's CRIT Rate exceeds 100%, every 1% of excess CRIT Rate increases CRIT DMG by 2%.
131306.desc_cn: 天赋的暴击率提高效果可以叠加，最多叠加3层，并使天赋的持续时间增加1回合。星期日施放终结技时，也可以为目标添加天赋的暴击率提高效果。天赋的暴击率提高效果生效时，当目标的暴击率超过100%，每溢出1%暴击率提高2%暴击伤害。

131401.name: Altruism? Nevertheless Tradable
131401.desc: The Follow-Up ATK DMG from Jade's Talent increases by 32%. After the "Debt Collector" character attacks and the number of the enemy target(s) hit is either 2 or 1, Jade additionally gains 1 or 2 point(s) of Charge respectively.
131401.desc_cn: 翡翠天赋的追加攻击伤害提高32%，持有【收债人】状态的角色施放攻击后击中敌方目标数量等于2/1名时，翡翠额外获得1/2点充能。

131402.name: Morality? Herein Authenticated
131402.desc: When there are 15 stacks of Pawned Asset, Jade's CRIT Rate increases by 18%.
131402.desc_cn: 【当品】叠加至15层时，翡翠暴击率提高18%。

131403.name: Honesty? Soon Mortgaged
131403.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
131403.desc_cn: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。

131404.name: Sincerity? Put Option Only
131404.desc: When using Ultimate, enables the DMG dealt by Jade to ignore 12% of enemy targets' DEF, lasting for 3 turn(s).
131404.desc_cn: 施放终结技时，使翡翠造成的伤害无视敌方目标12%的防御力，持续3回合。

131405.name: Hope? Hitherto Forfeited
131405.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
131405.desc_cn: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级。

131406.name: Equity? Pending Sponsorship
131406.desc: While the "Debt Collector" character exists on the field, Jade's Quantum RES PEN increases by 20%, and Jade gains the "Debt Collector" state.
131406.desc_cn: 场上有【收债人】状态的角色时，翡翠量子属性抗性穿透提高20%，同时翡翠获得【收债人】状态。

131501.name: Dusty Trail's Lone Star
131501.desc: When the battle starts, obtains 1 stack of Pocket Trickshot. When Boothill deals DMG, ignores 16% of the enemy target's DEF.
131501.desc_cn: 战斗开始时，获得1层【优势口袋】。波提欧造成伤害时无视敌方目标16%的防御力。

131502.name: Milestonemonger
131502.desc: When in Standoff and gaining Pocket Trickshot, recovers 1 Skill Point(s) and increases Break Effect by 30%, lasting for 2 turn(s). Can also trigger this effect when gaining Pocket Trickshot stacks that exceed the max limit. But cannot trigger repeatedly within one turn.
131502.desc_cn: 处于【绝命对峙】并获得【优势口袋】时，恢复1个战技点，并且击破特攻提高30%，持续2回合。该效果单个回合内不可重复触发，在获得溢出的【优势口袋】时也会触发。

131503.name: Marble Orchard's Guard
131503.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
131503.desc_cn: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级。

131504.name: Cold Cuts Chef
131504.desc: When the enemy target in the Standoff is attacked by Boothill, the DMG they receive additionally increases by 12%. When Boothill is attacked by the enemy target in the Standoff, the effect of him receiving increased DMG is offset by 12%.
131504.desc_cn: 处于【绝命对峙】的敌方目标受到波提欧攻击时，受到的伤害额外提高12%。波提欧受到处于【绝命对峙】的敌方目标的攻击时，受到的伤害提高效果降低12%。

131505.name: Stump Speech
131505.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
131505.desc_cn: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。

131506.name: Crowbar Hotel's Raccoon
131506.desc: When triggering the Talent's Break DMG, additionally deals Break DMG to the target equal to 40% of the original DMG multiplier and additionally deals Break DMG to adjacent targets equal to 70% of the original DMG multiplier.
131506.desc_cn: 触发天赋造成击破伤害时，对目标额外造成等同于原伤害倍率40%的击破伤害，对相邻目标额外造成等同于原伤害倍率70%的击破伤害。

131701.name: Returned Is the Revenant With No Ferry Toll
131701.desc: During the "Sealform" state entered by using Ultimate, DMG dealt by Rappa ignores 15% of the targets' DEF. After exiting the "Sealform" state, regenerates 20 Energy.
131701.desc_cn: 施放终结技进入【结印】状态期间，乱破造成的伤害无视目标15%的防御，退出【结印】状态后恢复20点能量。

131702.name: Free Is the Mind Enlightened by Haikus
131702.desc: The Enhanced Basic ATK's first 2 hits have their Toughness Reduction against the one designated enemy increased by 50%.
131702.desc_cn: 强化普攻的前2段攻击对指定敌方单体的削韧值提高50%。

131703.name: Many Are the Shrines That Repel No Hell
131703.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
131703.desc_cn: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。

131704.name: Lost Is the Nindō Devoured by Time
131704.desc: While in the "Sealform" state, increases all allies' SPD by 12%.
131704.desc_cn: 【结印】状态期间，我方全体速度提高12%。

131705.name: Steady Is The Ranger With Unerring Arrows
131705.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
131705.desc_cn: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级。

131706.name: Righteous Is the Wrath That Spares No Evil
131706.desc: When battle starts, Rappa gains 5 point(s) of her Talent's Charge, and its upper limit increases by 5 point(s). After launching the third hit of "Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade," gains 5 point(s) of Charge.
131706.desc_cn: 战斗开始时乱破获得5点天赋效果的充能，且充能上限增加5点。发动【忍具•降魔花弁】第3段攻击后获得5点充能。

132101.name: When a Bud Readies to Bloom
132101.desc: The Super Break DMG multiplier provided by Talent to "Dance Partners" now applies to all ally characters, with "Dance Partners" additionally receiving a 40% boost. After "Dance Partners" use an attack, additionally deals the attacked enemy targets a fixed amount of Toughness Reduction equal to 25% of their Max Toughness (minimum 10, maximum 300). This effect can only trigger once per enemy target, and this trigger count resets after the enemy target receives a killing blow.
132101.desc_cn: 天赋为【共舞者】提供的超击破伤害倍率对我方全体角色生效，其中【共舞者】的倍率额外提高40%。【共舞者】施放攻击后，对受到攻击的敌方目标额外造成等同于其韧性上限25%的固定削韧（至少10点，至多300点）。该效果每个敌方目标只能触发1次，敌方目标受到致命攻击后重置该目标的可触发次数。

132102.name: Fresh, Ethereal, and Beloved
132102.desc: When The Dahlia is on the field, decreases all enemies' All-Type RES by 20%. When an enemy target enters the field, immediately inflicts "Wilt" on them, lasting for 3 turn(s).
132102.desc_cn: 大丽花在场时，敌方全体全属性抗性降低20%。敌方目标入场时，立即陷入【败谢】状态，持续3回合。

132103.name: Pity Its Petals Thin as Mist
132103.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
132103.desc_cn: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级。

132104.name: Pity Its Heart Gnawed by Worms
132104.desc: Increases the number of DMG instances dealt by Talent's Follow-Up ATK by 5. Upon its use, the DMG taken by all enemy targets increases by 12%, lasting for 2 turn(s).
132104.desc_cn: 天赋的追加攻击的伤害次数增加5次，施放时使敌方全体目标受到的伤害提高12%，持续2回合。

132105.name: Fallen, Decayed, and Despised
132105.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
132105.desc_cn: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。

132106.name: And Yet, Always, Deathly Beautiful
132106.desc: Increases Dance Partners' Break Effect by 150%. When using Talent's Follow-Up ATK, advances the next action of all "Dance Partners" by 20%.
132106.desc_cn: 【共舞者】的击破特攻提高150%。施放天赋的追加攻击时，使所有【共舞者】下一次行动提前20%。

140101.name: Night at Shorefall
140101.desc: When the Enhanced Skill calculates the number of "Interpretation" stacks, additionally counts 50% of the number of "Interpretation" stacks on the 1 target with the most stacks among the primary target and adjacent targets. When "Interpretation" is reset by using the Enhanced Skill, its stack number is reset to 15 instead.
140101.desc_cn: 强化战技计算【解读】层数时，额外计算主目标及相邻目标中层数最高的1个目标当前【解读】层数的50%。施放强化战技重置【解读】时，改为将层数重置为15层。

140102.name: Wind Through Keyhole
140102.desc: After The Herta enters combat or uses Ultimate, additionally gains 1 "Inspiration" stack. After using Enhanced Skill, advances The Herta's next action by 35%.
140102.desc_cn: 大黑塔进入战斗和施放终结技后，额外获得1层【灵感】。施放强化战技后，大黑塔的下一次行动提前35%。

140103.name: Door into Summer
140103.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
140103.desc_cn: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。

140104.name: The Sixteenth Key
140104.desc: The SPD of Erudition characters in the team increases by 12%.
140104.desc_cn: 队伍中的「智识」命途角色的速度提高12%。

140105.name: Bitter Pill of Truth
140105.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
140105.desc_cn: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级。

140106.name: Sweet Lure of Answer
140106.desc: The Herta's Ice RES PEN increases by 20%. When the number of enemy targets on the field is (≥3)/2/1, Ultimate's DMG multiplier increases by 140%/250%/400% respectively.
140106.desc_cn: 大黑塔的冰属性抗性穿透提高20%，当场上敌方目标数量等于3或以上/2/1名时，终结技的伤害倍率提高140%/250%/400%。

140201.name: Drift at the Whim of Venus
140201.desc: The enemy afflicted with "Seam Stitch" takes 15% increased DMG. After Aglaea or Garmentmaker attacks this target, additionally regenerates 20 Energy.
140201.desc_cn: 处于【间隙织线】状态下的敌人受到的伤害提高15%，阿格莱雅或衣匠攻击该目标后额外恢复20点能量。

140202.name: Sail on the Raft of Eyelids
140202.desc: When Aglaea or Garmentmaker takes action, enables the DMG dealt by Aglaea and Garmentmaker to ignore 14% of the target's DEF. This effect stacks up to 3 time(s) and lasts until any unit, other than Aglaea or Garmentmaker, actively uses an ability.
140202.desc_cn: 当阿格莱雅或衣匠行动时，使阿格莱雅与衣匠造成的伤害无视目标14%的防御力，该效果最多叠加3层，持续至除自身与衣匠以外的任意单位主动施放技能时。

140203.name: Bequeath in the Coalescence of Dew
140203.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Memosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
140203.desc_cn: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级；忆灵天赋等级+1，最多不超过10级。

140204.name: Flicker Below the Surface of Marble
140204.desc: The SPD Boost effect from the Memosprite Talent has its max stack limit increased by 1. After Aglaea uses an attack, can also make Garmentmaker gain the SPD Boost effect from the Memosprite Talent.
140204.desc_cn: 忆灵天赋的速度提高效果层数上限提高1层。阿格莱雅施放攻击后也能使衣匠获得忆灵天赋的速度提高效果。

140205.name: Weave Under the Shroud of Woe
140205.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

150306.desc_cn: 【深度学习】时，我方全体目标的全属性抗性穿透提高20%。真珠的强化普攻额外造成240%的冰属性欢愉伤害，该次欢愉伤害使用【美学底本】的属性值计算。

1110201.name: Extirpating Slash
1110201.desc: When dealing DMG to an enemy whose HP percentage is 80% or lower, increases CRIT Rate by 15%, and ignores 20% of target's DEF.
1110201.desc_cn: 对当前生命值百分比小于等于80%的敌方目标造成伤害时，暴击率提高15%且无视目标20%的防御力。

1110202.name: Dancing Butterfly
1110202.desc: The SPD Boost effect of Seele's Skill can stack up to 2 time(s).
1110202.desc_cn: 战技的加速效果可以叠加，最多叠加2层。

1110203.name: Dazzling Tumult
1110203.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
1110203.desc_cn: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。

1110204.name: Flitting Phantasm
1110204.desc: Seele regenerates 15 Energy when she defeats an enemy.
1110204.desc_cn: 希儿消灭敌方目标时，自身恢复15点能量。

1110205.name: Piercing Shards
1110205.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
1110205.desc_cn: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级。

1110206.name: Shattering Shambles
1110206.desc:
After attacking with Ultimate, Seele inflicts "Butterfly Flurry" on the target for 3 turn(s). Enemy targets in "Butterfly Flurry" will additionally take 1 instance of True DMG equal to 30% of Seele's Ultimate DMG after receiving an attack. When the target under the "Butterfly Flurry" state is defeated by any unit, Seele's Talent will also be triggered.
When Seele is knocked down, the "Butterfly Flurry" inflicted on the enemies will be removed.
1110206.desc_cn:
施放终结技后使目标陷入【乱蝶】状态，持续3回合。【乱蝶】状态下的敌方目标受到攻击后，额外受到1次等同于希儿本次终结技伤害30%的真实伤害。处于【乱蝶】状态下的敌人被任意单位消灭时，也会触发希儿的天赋。
当希儿陷入无法战斗状态时，敌方目标的【乱蝶】状态被解除。

1121701.name: Anchored to Vessel, Specters Nestled
1121701.desc: The duration of "Divine Provision" produced by the Talent is extended by 1 turn(s). When Huohuo possesses "Divine Provision," her Outgoing Healing increases by 20%, all allies' SPD increases by 12%.
1121701.desc_cn: 天赋产生的【禳命】持续时间延长1回合，当藿藿拥有【禳命】时自身治疗量提高20%，并使我方全体速度提高12%。

1121702.name: Sealed in Tail, Wraith Subdued
1121702.desc: If Huohuo possesses "Divine Provision" when an ally target is struck by a killing blow, the ally will not be knocked down and their HP will immediately be restored by an amount equal to 50% of their Max HP. This reduces the duration of "Divine Provision" by 1 turn. This effect can only be triggered 2 time(s) per battle.
1121702.desc_cn: 当藿藿拥有【禳命】时，若我方目标受到致命攻击，不会陷入无法战斗状态，并立即回复等同于其自身生命上限50%的生命值，使【禳命】的持续回合数减1。该效果单场战斗中可以触发2次。

1121703.name: Cursed by Fate, Moths to Flame
1121703.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
1121703.desc_cn: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。

1121704.name: Tied in Life, Bound to Strife
1121704.desc: When healing an ally target via Skill or Talent, the less HP the target ally currently has, the higher the amount of healing they will receive. The maximum increase in healing provided by Huohuo is 80%.
1121704.desc_cn: 施放战技或触发天赋为我方目标提供治疗时，目标的当前生命值越低治疗量越高，最多使藿藿提供的治疗量提高80%。

1121705.name: Mandated by Edict, Evils Evicted
1121705.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
1121705.desc_cn: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级。

1121706.name: Woven Together, Cohere Forever
1121706.desc: When healing an ally target, increases the ally target's DMG dealt by 50% for 2 turn(s).
1121706.desc_cn: 为我方目标提供治疗时，使目标造成的伤害提高50%，持续2回合。

1131001.name: In Reddened Chrysalis, I Once Rest
1131001.desc: When using the Enhanced Skill, ignores 15% of the target's DEF. The Enhanced Skill does not consume Skill Points.
1131001.desc_cn: 施放强化战技时无视目标15%的防御，且强化战技不消耗战技点。

1131002.name: From Shattered Sky, I Free Fall
1131002.desc: While in Complete Combustion, using the Enhanced Basic ATK or the Enhanced Skill to defeat an enemy target or to Break their Weakness allows SAM to immediately gain 1 extra turn. This effect can only trigger 1 time per turn, and the trigger count resets at the start of SAM's turn.
1131002.desc_cn: 「完全燃烧」状态下施放强化普攻、强化战技消灭敌方目标或使目标陷入弱点击破状态时，装甲「萨姆」立即获得1个额外回合。该效果每回合可触发1次，装甲「萨姆」回合开始时重置可触发次数。

1131003.name: Amidst Silenced Stars, I Deep Sleep
1131003.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
1131003.desc_cn: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级。

1131004.name: Upon Lighted Fyrefly, I Soon Gaze
1131004.desc: While in Complete Combustion, increases SAM's Effect RES by 50%.
1131004.desc_cn: 「完全燃烧」状态下，装甲「萨姆」的效果抵抗提高50%。

1131005.name: From Undreamt Night, I Thence Shine
1131005.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
1131005.desc_cn: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。

1131006.name: In Finalized Morrow, I Full Bloom
1131006.desc: While in Complete Combustion, increases SAM's Fire RES PEN by 20%. When using the Enhanced Basic ATK or Enhanced Skill, increases Weakness Break Efficiency by 50%.
1131006.desc_cn: 「完全燃烧」状态下装甲「萨姆」的火属性抗性穿透提高20%。施放强化普攻、强化战技时弱点击破效率提高50%。

151201.name: Stray Bird of Summer
151201.desc: "Summer Songbirds" will keep a tally of 100% of the non-True DMG dealt by ally targets. When using the Memosprite Skill, additionally deals True DMG to the enemy target with the highest HP, equal to (11% + current Vibes × 0.1%) of the total tally. Then, clears 50% of the tally.
151201.desc_cn: 「晴空乐手」会记录我方目标造成的非真实伤害的100%，施放忆灵技时对生命值最高的敌方目标额外造成记录伤害总额（11%+当前气氛值点数*0.1%）的真实伤害，随后清空记录值的50%。

151202.name: A Heart of Still Water
151202.desc: Ally targets' All-Type RES PEN increases by 18%. The upper limit of Robin • Summeretto's Vibes increases by 20. The first time an ally target uses an ability during any target's turn to cause Robin • Summeretto to gain Vibes, she gains an additional 2 points.
151202.desc_cn: 我方目标的全属性抗性穿透提高18%。知更鸟•晴歌的气氛值上限提高20点，我方目标在任意目标回合内第一次施放技能使知更鸟•晴歌获得气氛值时额外获得2点。

151203.name: Echoes Left Along the Way
151203.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Memosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
151203.desc_cn: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级；忆灵天赋等级+1，最多不超过10级。

151204.name: Her Variation on the Theme
151204.desc: Upon entering the "Fever" state, immediately gains 12 Vibes, and increases the SPD of "Summer Songbirds" by an amount equal to (20% + current Vibes × 0.5%).
151204.desc_cn: 进入【Fever】状态时，立即获得12点气氛值，「晴空乐手」的速度提高（20%+当前气氛值*0.5%）。

151205.name: To Chase the Dawn Anew
151205.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Memosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
151205.desc_cn: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级；忆灵技等级+1，最多不超过10级。

151206.name: A Song Yet Unnamed
151206.desc: Increases the Memosprite Skill's DMG multiplier by 100% of its original value. While in the "Fever" state, Robin • Summeretto can store her Ultimate up to 2 times. After entering the "Fever" state for the first time in this battle or when the the "Fever" countdown's turn starts, regenerates a fixed 140 Energy.
151206.desc_cn: 忆灵技的伤害倍率提高原倍率的100%。处于【Fever】状态时，知更鸟•晴歌的终结技可以最多储存2次，本场战斗中第一次进入【Fever】状态后或【Fever】倒计时回合开始时，固定恢复140点能量。

150601.name: Aether Editing: Eidolon +1
150601.desc:
Enemy targets in the Zone take 20% increased DMG.
When exiting the "Godmode Player" state, "Hidden MMR" will not be cleared. Instead, 20% of "Hidden MMR" will be retained.
150601.desc_cn:
结界中的敌方目标受到的伤害提高20%。
退出【无敌玩家】状态时不会清空【隐藏分】，改为保留20%的【隐藏分】。

150602.name: It's a Feature, Not a Bug
150602.desc: After entering the "Godmode Player" state, extends the duration of all buffs on this unit by 1 turn. In the current "Godmode Player" state, for every 120 point(s) of "Hidden MMR" increased (including the initial "Hidden MMR"), Silver Wolf LV.999 gains 1 extra turn and regains 1 use of Enhanced Basic ATK.
150602.desc_cn: 进入【无敌玩家】状态后，使自身所有增益效果延长1回合。本次【无敌玩家】状态下每使【隐藏分】提高120点（含初始【隐藏分】），「银狼LV.999」获得1个额外回合并恢复1次强化普攻的可施放次数。

150603.name: Max Lv. 15? Says who?
150603.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
150603.desc_cn: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级；欢愉技等级+1，最多不超过15级。

150604.name: I Came. I Saw. I One-Shot.
150604.desc: Elation DMG dealt by "Honkai-DMG Demo" additionally takes into account Punchline, equal to the original amount multiplied by 5.
150604.desc_cn: 【崩坏级伤害演示】造成的欢愉伤害额外计入5倍的笑点。

150605.name: Basic ATK Is the New Ultimate
150605.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
150605.desc_cn: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级；欢愉技等级+1，最多不超过15级。

150606.name: Solo Maxxing!
150606.desc:
Elation DMG dealt during Enhanced Basic ATK merrymakes by 50%.
When enemy targets enter combat, they are implanted with "Absolute Weakness": Has All-Type Weakness, and reduces their All-Type Base RES to 0. (If Base RES is already at 0, then the corresponding Type RES decreases by 20% instead).
150606.desc_cn:
强化普攻期间造成的欢愉伤害增笑50%。
敌方目标进入战斗时，会被植入【禁限弱点】：拥有全属性弱点并且全属性基础抗性降低至0（若基础抗性为0则改为对应属性抗性降低20%）。

1100401.name: Legacy of Honor
1100401.desc: After using a Skill or Ultimate to hit a target in the "Weightless" state, additionally deals 1 instance of Imaginary Additional DMG equal to 40% of the Ultimate's DMG multiplier. This effect can only be triggered once per target per attack.
1100401.desc_cn: 施放战技或终结技击中【失重】状态下的目标后，额外造成1次等同于终结技伤害倍率40%的虚数属性附加伤害。该效果每个目标每次受到攻击最多触发1次。

1100402.name: Conflux of Stars
1100402.desc: When his Talent is triggered, Welt regenerates 3 Energy.
1100402.desc_cn: 触发天赋时，瓦尔特恢复3点能量。

1100403.name: Prayer of Peace
1100403.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
1100403.desc_cn: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级。

1100404.name: Appellation of Justice
1100404.desc: Enemy targets in the "Weightless" state have their All-Type RES reduced by 30%.
1100404.desc_cn: 【失重】状态下的敌方目标全属性抗性降低30%。

1100405.name: Power of Kindness
1100405.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
1100405.desc_cn: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。

1100406.name: Prospect of Glory
1100406.desc: When using Skill or Ultimate to hit an enemy target in the Slow state, increases CRIT Rate by 30% and CRIT DMG by 60% for the DMG dealt.
1100406.desc_cn: 施放战技或终结技击中减速状态下的敌方目标时，造成伤害的暴击率提高30%，暴击伤害提高60%。

151301.name: A Holiday on the Line
151301.desc:
Increases All-Type RES PEN by 24%.
Talent gets enhanced: When "Fervor" reaches 10/20/30 points, immediately uses "Cheers! To Summer's Blaze."
151301.desc_cn:
全属性抗性穿透提高24%。
天赋获得强化：【热意】达到10点/20点/30点时，都会立即施放【举杯！敬炽烈一夏】。

151302.name: Idle as the Turning Tide
151302.desc: Increases the upper limit of "Fervor" to 50 points. "Fervor" reaching 40/50 points can also trigger the Talent to use "Cheers! To Summer's Blaze." After using Elation Skill, additionally gains 4 "Fervor."
151302.desc_cn: 【热意】上限提高至50点，达到40点/50点时，也会触发天赋施放【举杯！敬炽烈一夏】。施放欢愉技后额外获得4点【热意】。

151303.name: A Rendezvous Served Chilled
151303.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
151303.desc_cn: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级；欢愉技等级+1，最多不超过15级。

151304.name: Sunlight Runs No Tab
151304.desc: When Aventurine • Waveflair uses Skill, enables the DMG dealt by all allies to ignore 18% of enemy targets' DEF, lasting for 3 turn(s).
151304.desc_cn: 砂金•戏浪施放战技时，使我方全体造成的伤害无视敌方目标18%的防御力，持续3回合。

151305.name: Into the Eye of the Jackpot
151305.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
151305.desc_cn: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级；欢愉技等级+1，最多不超过15级。

151306.name: The Past in Fast Lane
151306.desc: Elation DMG dealt by Aventurine • Waveflair merrymakes by 25%. After Aventurine • Waveflair uses his Elation Skill 2 time(s), all subsequent Elation Skills used become "All In! To Summer's Blaze." And when using the Elation Skill "All In! To Summer's Blaze" to additionally deal DMG outside of Aha Instant, it no longer consumes "Fervor."
151306.desc_cn: 砂金•戏浪造成的欢愉伤害增笑25%。砂金•戏浪施放2次欢愉技后，其后续施放的所有欢愉技均为【All in！敬炽烈一夏】，且在阿哈时刻外施放欢愉技【All in！敬炽烈一夏】造成额外伤害时不再消耗【热意】。

150701.name: Ere My Death, I Stood Unmade
150701.desc: While the Zone is active, decreases all enemies' All-Type RES by 20%. After using the extra Skill from Talent, the "Infinite Fury" countdown has its action delayed by 15%.
150701.desc_cn: 结界持续期间，使敌方全体全属性抗性降低20%，施放天赋的额外战技后使【无量忿怒】倒计时行动延后15%。

150702.name: Ash Was My Heart, Yet the Flame Stayed
150702.desc: When an ally character uses Ultimate to deal DMG, it is considered as having launched Follow-Up ATK. And the Follow-Up ATK DMG dealt by ally targets increases by 75%. The upper limit of Mortenax Blade's Charge decreases to 7.
150702.desc_cn: 我方角色施放终结技造成伤害时，被视为发动了追加攻击，我方目标造成的追加攻击伤害提高75%。千冶•刃充能点的上限降低至7。

150703.name: Across the Shore, Wrath Laid Bare
150703.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
150703.desc_cn: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。

150704.name: Odium I've Smitten, Thence Came the Blade
150704.desc: "Heart, Refined ad Infinitum" additionally increases ally targets' DMG dealt by 50%.
150704.desc_cn: 【万淬心】使我方目标造成的伤害额外提高50%。

150705.name: I Severed My Woes, Knowing Death Begets Life
150705.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
150705.desc_cn: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级。

150706.name: If Immortality Could Die, I Swore THEM Slain
150706.desc: As the Zone persists, when Mortenax Blade takes DMG or consumes HP, he gains 1 Charge. This effect can trigger again after any target's turn ends. The DMG multiplier of "Tenax Per Ignem" increases to 150% of its original value.
150706.desc_cn: 结界持续期间，千冶•刃受到伤害或消耗生命值时，获得1点充能，该效果在任意目标回合结束后可再次触发。【千冶铸一，万劫烬灭】的伤害倍率提高为原倍率的150%。

101401.name: The Lost White Walls
101401.desc: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by Saber by 60%. After Saber uses Basic ATK or Skill, gains 1 "Core Resonance."
101401.desc_cn: Saber造成的终结技伤害提高60%。Saber施放普攻或战技后，获得1点【炉心共鸣】。

101402.name: The Lost Oath of the Round Table
101402.desc: For every 1 point of "Core Resonance" gained in this battle, Saber's DMG dealt ignores 1.0% of the target's DEF. This effect stacks up to 15 time(s). When triggering the "Core Resonance" effect to boost Skill's multiplier, each point of "Core Resonance" additionally increases the DMG multiplier for the current instance of Skill by 7%.
101402.desc_cn: 本场战斗中每获得1点【炉心共鸣】，使Saber造成的伤害无视目标1.0%的防御力，该效果最多叠加15层。触发【炉心共鸣】提高战技倍率的效果时，每点【炉心共鸣】额外使本次战技的伤害倍率提高7%。

101403.name: A Wish Across Fifteen Centuries
101403.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
101403.desc_cn: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级。

101404.name: The Saga of Sixteen Winter Days
101404.desc: Increases Saber's Wind RES PEN by 8%. After using Ultimate, increases Saber's Wind RES PEN by 4%. This effect stacks up to 3 time(s).
101404.desc_cn: Saber的风属性抗性穿透提高8%。施放终结技后，Saber的风属性抗性穿透提高4%，该效果最多叠加3层。

101405.name: The Dreamed Utopian Dawn
101405.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
101405.desc_cn: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。

101406.name: The Long Fated Night

After using Ultimate for the first time upon entering combat, regenerates a fixed amount of 300 Energy for Saber. This effect can trigger 1 time after every 3 Ultimate use(s).
101406.desc_cn: Saber造成的终结技伤害的风属性抗性穿透提高20%，行迹【湖之祝福】可积攒的溢出能量提高到200点。进入战斗首次施放终结技后，为Saber固定恢复300点能量，该效果每再施放3次终结技可触发1次。

101501.name: The Unreached Dream

101501.desc_cn: 单个回合内施放3次战技后，为我方恢复2个战技点。

101502.name: The Unfulfilled Happiness

101504.name: The Unsung Life

101506.desc: When the turn starts, recovers 1 Skill Point for allies. The maximum number of stacks allowed for the DMG boost effect provided by this unit's Skill increases by 1. The Skill DMG dealt ignores 20% of DEF.
101506.desc_cn: 回合开始时为我方恢复1个战技点。自身战技提供的伤害提高效果可以叠加的上限层数提高1层。造成的战技伤害无视20%的防御力。

150801.name: Zelretch's Apprentice
150801.desc:
If one instance of the Enhanced Skill consumes 30 or more "Gem Energy," Rin Tohsaka gains "Shadow Gem" equal to the amount of "Gem Energy" consumed.
While holding "Shadow Gem," enhances Skill to "Second Magic Experiment." The Enhanced Skill consumes all "Shadow Gem," does not trigger the effect that converts Skill Points into "Gem Energy," and does not consume "Gem Energy."
150801.desc_cn:
若单次强化战技消耗的【宝石能量】数量大于等于30点，远坂凛获得与消耗的【宝石能量】数量相同的【影子宝石】。
持有【影子宝石】时，战技强化为【第二魔法实验】，强化战技会消耗所有【影子宝石】，不触发将战技点转化为【宝石能量】的效果且不消耗【宝石能量】。

150802.name: Dimensional Traveler
150802.desc: Rin Tohsaka's Skill DMG dealt increases by 30%. While Rin Tohsaka is on the field, Skill DMG dealt by all allies becomes 130% of the original DMG.
150802.desc_cn: 远坂凛造成的战技伤害提高30%。远坂凛在场时，我方全体造成的战技伤害为原伤害的130%。

150804.desc_cn: 天赋【宝石魔术】的暴击伤害提高效果对远坂凛生效时，效果可以叠加，最多可叠加2层。

150806.desc_cn: 远坂凛的全属性抗性穿透提高20%。施放终结技时，获得24点【宝石能量】和1个额外回合。

150901.name: He Who Saw the Deep
150901.desc: When Gilgamesh holds "King's Acknowledgement," its DEF-ignoring effect also applies to other teammates, and "King's Acknowledgement" additionally increases Gilgamesh's ATK by 60%. When using Skill, additionally regenerates a fixed 40 Energy.
150901.desc_cn: 当吉尔伽美什持有【王来承认】时，【王来承认】无视防御力的效果对其他队友也生效，且【王来承认】额外使吉尔伽美什攻击力提高60%。施放战技时额外固定恢复40能量。

150902.desc: When entering combat, Gilgamesh gains 5 "Interest." When using Ultimate, additionally gains 5 "Interest." The DMG multiplier of the Skill "Gate of Babylon" against the primary target increases by 100%, and its DMG multiplier against adjacent targets increases by 50%.
150902.desc_cn: 吉尔伽美什进入战斗时获得5点【兴致】，施放终结技时额外获得5点【兴致】。战技【王之财宝】对主目标造成的伤害倍率提高100%，对相邻目标造成的伤害倍率提高50%。

When this unit uses Ultimate, consumes all "Golden Rule" points, and each point of "Golden Rule" consumed increases the CRIT DMG for the Ultimate DMG dealt by 100%.
150906.desc_cn: 终结技【天地乖离•开辟之星】的弹射伤害倍率提高80%。吉尔伽美什在场时，使我方角色的全属性抗性穿透提高20%。队友施放终结技时，吉尔伽美什获得1点【黄金律】，最多累计3点。自身施放终结技时消耗全部【黄金律】，每消耗1点【黄金律】使造成的终结技伤害的暴击伤害提高100%。
